This package contains the following policies:

## `network`

- cnp-egress-nginx-hardening-rule-allow-only-port-25

Allow only SMTP Port 25

- cnp-egress-nginx-hardening-rule-allow-only-port-123

Allow only NTP Port 123

- cnp-ingress-nginx-hardening-policy-allow-only-get-on-port-80

Allow HTTP GET on Port 80

- cnp-ingress-nginx-hardening-policy-allow-only-head-on-port-80

Allow HTTP HEAD on Port 80

- cnp-ingress-nginx-hardening-policy-allow-only-post-on-port-80

Allow HTTP POST on Port 80
